description: 镜头动机规则包（2026-08-15 v0.13.1 实测校准）：动机类型学 + 动机→镜头工具包 + 本地触发词 + J/L-Cut 表 + 审查规则。镜头动机=导演通过呈现什么画面向观众传递什么信息/情绪/衔接理由；形式学依据：波德维尔《电影艺术》动机=元素出现的正当理由（现实认知/叙事/类型惯例/风格模式四来源）。机制：本地确定性推导为主（节拍自身文本打分+位置规则+场景类型回退），LLM 在低置信节拍上辅助生成并本地校验；**镜头动机为后台数据，不进提示词（自研产品护城河，2026-08-15 决策）**；审查走后台日志。

info_introduce_env.name: 介绍环境
info_introduce_env.goal_zh: 让观众先建立空间与氛围认知

info_introduce_person.name: 介绍人物
info_introduce_person.goal_zh: 让观众认出人物并建立其在场感
info_introduce_person.goal_en: introduce the character and establish presence

info_reaction.name: 展现反馈
info_reaction.goal_zh: 让观众看到听者对说话内容的反应
info_reaction.goal_en: show the listener's reaction to what is being said

info_result.name: 展现结果/细节
info_result.goal_zh: 用局部特写让观众看清关键动作的结果或细节
info_result.goal_en: show the outcome or key detail via close-up

info_reveal.name: 揭示悬念
info_reveal.goal_zh: 延迟揭示，逐步揭开真相或身份
info_reveal.goal_en: delay the reveal, unveil truth or identity gradually

info_relation.name: 交代关系
info_relation.goal_zh: 让观众看懂人物间的空间与权力关系
info_relation.goal_en: make spatial and power relations legible

emotion_amplify.name: 放大情绪
emotion_amplify.goal_zh: 把角色的内心情绪放大给观众

emotion_pressure.name: 制造压迫/不安
emotion_pressure.goal_zh: 用角度与构图营造压迫或不安
emotion_pressure.goal_en: create pressure or unease through angle and framing

emotion_haste.name: 展现匆忙/动势
emotion_haste.goal_zh: 用局部+运动压缩传递'赶路/慌乱'的动势
emotion_haste.goal_en: convey haste or urgency through partial view and motion

grammar_cut.name: 连接/转场
grammar_cut.goal_zh: 让镜头衔接有理由（新信息/视线/动作/声音）
grammar_cut.goal_en: motivate the cut (new info, eyeline, action, or sound)

grammar_reaction.name: 反应衔接
grammar_reaction.goal_zh: 在对话中给听者反应镜头，形成正反打
grammar_reaction.goal_en: insert the listener's reaction in dialogue, forming shot-reverse-shot

info_introduce_env.zh: 远景建立空间，缓推或横移扫过环境，让观众先看到'在哪里'
info_introduce_env.en: wide establishing shot; slow push or lateral pan across the space so the audience sees WHERE first

info_introduce_person.zh: 由远及近收束：先让人物入画（中景），再逐步推近到中近景/特写，完成'他是谁'的信息递进
info_introduce_person.en: narrow from medium to close-up in stages: bring the character into frame, then push in, completing the WHO

info_reaction.zh: 切到听者反应镜头（正反打）；若台词继续而画面已切，用 L-Cut：声音先入、画面提前到反应
info_reaction.en: cut to the listener's reaction (shot-reverse-shot); if the line continues over the cut, use L-Cut: audio leads, picture lands on the reaction

info_result.zh: 用局部特写（马蹄/剑尖/伤口）压缩关键结果，低机位增强动势与分量
info_result.en: use an insert close-up (hoof, blade, wound) to compress the key outcome; low angle adds weight and momentum

info_reveal.camera_pos: 延迟揭示机位（前景遮挡/景深）
info_reveal.zh: 先局部/遮挡延迟揭示，再逐步聚焦；rack focus 或前景虚焦引导视线到真相
info_reveal.en: delay the reveal with partial view or obstruction, then rack focus or push to the truth

info_relation.zh: 用双人/全景交代相对位置与权力关系，保持 180° 轴线恒定
info_relation.en: use a two-shot or wide to lay out relative position and power, keeping the 180-degree line stable

emotion_amplify.zh: 特写+缓推+浅景深放大内心情绪，留白给情绪
emotion_amplify.en: close-up plus slow push plus shallow depth to amplify inner emotion, leaving breathing room

emotion_pressure.zh: 低机位仰拍或荷兰角制造压迫/不安
emotion_pressure.en: low-angle tilt-up or Dutch angle to create pressure or unease

emotion_haste.zh: 低机位特写局部（马蹄/脚步）+ 侧面跟拍，用动势代替全景交代'赶路'
emotion_haste.en: low-angle insert (hooves, feet) plus lateral tracking; convey haste through momentum instead of a full wide

grammar_cut.zh: 剪切必须有理由：新信息/视线/动作/声音；转场用匹配剪辑或 J/L-Cut
grammar_cut.en: every cut needs a reason: new info, eyeline, action, or sound; use match cuts or J/L-Cut for transitions

grammar_reaction.zh: 对话中给听者反应，正反打保持视线匹配；画面先入可用 J-Cut（先看到反应再听到台词）
grammar_reaction.en: insert the listener's reaction in dialogue; shot-reverse-shot keeps eyeline; use J-Cut when the picture leads and the line follows

l_cut.name: L-Cut（声音先入）
l_cut.zh: L-Cut（声音先入）：上一镜头的声音延续到下一个画面（用于：A 说话时切到 B/C 的反应，台词声继续）
l_cut.en: L-Cut (audio leads): audio from the previous shot continues over the next picture (show B/C's reaction while A keeps talking)

j_cut.name: J-Cut（画面先入）
j_cut.zh: J-Cut（画面先入）：下一个画面的声音提前进入（用于：先看到新场景/新人物，再听到其声音）
j_cut.en: J-Cut (picture leads): the next picture's audio enters before the cut (see the new scene or character before hearing it)

unmotivated_patterns: 特写无情绪或信息目标
空镜无氛围或信息目标
review_rules.zh: 每镜必须有镜头动机：向观众传达什么信息/情绪/衔接理由；无动机镜头（无信息增量/无情绪变化/无衔接理由）判为不合格
review_rules.en: Every shot must have a motivation: what info, emotion, or connection it delivers; unmotivated shots (no new info, no emotional change, no connective reason) fail

motivation_formalism.source: 波德维尔《电影艺术：形式与风格》插图修订第8版（大卫·波德维尔、克里斯汀·汤普森）· 动机形式学（2026-08-15 投喂学习）
motivation_formalism.definition_zh: 动机 = 影片中某一元素出现的正当理由：观众期待任何元素都有在此出现的逻辑解释
motivation_formalism.definition_en: motivation = the justification for an element's presence; audiences expect every element to have a logical reason for being there

realistic.name: 写实动机
realistic.source_zh: 观众对现实世界的认知
realistic.zh: 元素因符合现实世界的逻辑/常理而正当（蜡烛给光一个理由、人物行为符合现实）
realistic.en: justified by the audience's knowledge of the real world (a candle motivates the light; behavior follows real-world logic)

narrative.name: 叙事动机
narrative.zh: 元素因服务于故事因果/角色目标/平行对照而正当（角色特征驱动事件、基础动机驱动整体结构）
narrative.en: justified by narrative factors: story causality, character goals, parallelism

intertextual.name: 互文动机
intertextual.zh: 元素因类型/体裁惯例而正当（歌舞片里歌唱、新闻报道类型、恐怖片吓人公式）
intertextual.en: justified by genre/convention (singing in a musical, reportage conventions, horror formulas)

artistic.name: 艺术动机
artistic.zh: 元素因影片风格/视觉母题/形式模式而正当（风格化机位、视觉平行、母题重复）
artistic.en: justified by the film's stylistic patterns, motifs, and formal design

motivation_formalism.principle_zh: 经典好莱坞叙事：动机越清楚越完整越好；艺术片可有意暧昧化。无动机元素=形式不统一。
motivation_formalism.principle_en: Classical Hollywood keeps motivation clear and complete; art films may deliberately leave it ambiguous. Unmotivated elements = formal disunity.
